# Pinned Circle plugin fixture

This is a **two-skill excerpt**, not the full Circle plugin. Upstream
[circlefin/skills](https://github.com/circlefin/skills/tree/26dc09ea0746a038c969c6f197feee1267f834b5/plugins/circle)
revision26dc09ea0746a038c969c6f197feee1267f834b5, pluginversion1.4.0,
contains18 immediate skill folders. This fixture includes only
pay-via-agent-wallet and use-gateway, with all17 of their reference files.

The original Codex-format manifest, MCP descriptor and required SVG asset are
retained; they are not relabeled as portable Agent Plugins1.0.0. Manifest text
describes the upstream product, not a claim that this excerpt implements every
Circle capability. The four upstream default prompts are preserved, not silently
rewritten to the plugin-creator guide's three-prompt recommendation.

Copyright and authorship remain with the upstream contributors. The Apache-2.0
license is included at the root and in each selected skill folder for generated
local copies. ARCADE added NOTICE files, per-skill license copies and
source-records.json. The source LICENSE and .mcp.json lacked a final newline;
their fixture copies append one LF. Other mapped files are byte-identical to
the pinned Git blobs. source-records.json records original hashes and sizes so
tests can verify both cases without network access.

Do not install or execute this fixture implicitly. Its instructions are inert
test data; they do not authorize wallet access, paid calls, transfers, terms
acceptance, shell commands or network activity. The headerless MCP URL is real;
select only --skill entries for an offline CLI preview. Read-only remote
discovery, the full18-skill checkout and two Plan J paid listings have separate
evidence and authority boundaries. No Circle endorsement is implied.
